question: Should CodexBar expose a persisted Claude setting that lets a single claude-swap account take precedence over the ambient Claude presentation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically bounded and preserves existing behavior by default, but whether this additional provider-policy control belongs in the supported product surface requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the opt-in setting
options.body: Merge the default-off setting, preserving existing zero-account and ordinary single-account fallback behavior unless a user deliberately enables it.

options.title: Keep multi-account-only precedence
options.body: Decline the added setting and retain the existing rule that claude-swap replaces ambient Claude only with two or more accounts.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in setting
recommendation.body: Merge the default-off setting, preserving existing zero-account and ordinary single-account fallback behavior unless a user deliberately enables it.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged claude-swap integration and its original precedence boundary.
